# Looper Support

Looper is maintained on a best-effort basis by
[@foolzzz](https://github.com/foolzzz). There is no response-time commitment
and no commercial support.

| Need | Where |
| --- | --- |
| A reproducible bug or installation failure | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/foolzzz/looper/issues/new/choose) |
| A feature request | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/foolzzz/looper/issues/new/choose) |
| A usage question | [Open an issue](https://github.com/foolzzz/looper/issues/new/choose) and describe what you tried |
| A security vulnerability | Report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), never in an issue |

Search the existing issues first. For a bug, include the Looper version
(`looper version`), the entry point (dashboard, Telegram, Lark or CLI), what you
did, what you expected, what happened, and the smallest reproduction you can
share. Remove credentials, private repository content, raw agent transcripts,
runtime state and local paths before posting.

Published versions and their notes are on the
[releases page](https://github.com/foolzzz/looper/releases). How to
contribute is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
